additional_transports.local_library_account_fetch: Already captures expected account + library scope + every Session-write revision, post-response authoritative identity reconciliation; no replay. Device IndexedDB writes stay local and do not need browser-session authority.
additional_transports.announcement_reconstruction: Direct fetch mutation exception migrated to common authenticatedMutation with owned manage-page intent; current-identity personal reads fenced and anonymous credentials omitted.
additional_transports.auth_flow_SDK: Separate CSRF/browser-flow contract; anonymous signup/login/verification/recovery/reset-only capability must not be bound as normal native account writes.
additional_transports.original_signed_protocol: Explicit external signer/admission/recipient authority; protocol signing and exact durable outbox are separate from password Session.
additional_transports.public_read_only_mapping_POST: Protocol resources/import mapping resolution uses credentials omit, no authenticated account mutation.
additional_transports.upload: Owned immutable target/actor captures + central native HTTP expected-account fence; multipart input snapshotted before queue.
additional_transports.public_GET: Not blanket-blocked; specific personal reply/follow/announcement projections omit anonymous credentials or verify matching actor before/after reads.
